name: codex-app-workbench
description: A safe workbench for Codex SDK threads and dynamically discovered Codex apps.

scripts.apps: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js apps installed
scripts.app-catalog: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js apps list
scripts.brief: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js brief
scripts.chat: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js chat
